verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Tap to Pay on iPhone solution that accepts contactless in-person payments using the iPhone itself as the payment interface. Its POS marketing page says it turns compatible smartphones or tablets into Tap to Pay checkouts with 'No extra hardware required', which covers the no-reader part of the story. Missing for 10: detailed docs for Android or other non-iPhone devices (only implied by the marketing page), device compatibility and regional availability details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
